note: one start per stage1_large box pose (same order); per start: box pose (x, y m; yaw deg) and each duck's x, y (m) and yaw (deg). Kinds: uniform (each duck 0.2-0.8 m from the box centre, bearing and heading uniform), near_symmetric (both ducks within 2 cm of the box's push axis, so both pairings with the spots are about equally long), wrong_side (both ducks within 60 deg of the push direction, on the target side). Neither duck within 8 cm of the box, ducks at least 15 cm apart. Never used in training. Episode seed 10000 + i.
